title: Enrich Nodes
description: Enrich threat data objects for threat investigation using third-party enrichment tools configured in Intel Exchange.

query.name: page
query.description: Pass the page number to retrieve enrichment results.

query.name: page_size
query.description: Pass the number of results to retrieve per page.

body.name: object_id
body.description: Pass the ID of the threat data object.

body.name: object_type
body.description: Pass the type of the threat data object such as `indicator`, `vulnerability`, and more.

body.name: type
body.description: Pass the type or the sub type of the threat data object such as `url`, `domain`, `ipv4-addr`, and more.

body.name: app_slug
body.description:
Pass the slug of an enrichment tool to use for enrichment. To retrieve the list of enrichment tools, use the **GET
Enrichment Tools API**.

body.name: action_slug
body.description: Pass the slug value of the action. For example, `get_ip`.

body.name: value
body.description: Pass the value of the threat data object.

body.name: identifier
body.description: Pass `ctix` to indicate that the threat data object already exists in the Intel Exchange database. If you pass anything else, it indicates a custom object.

body.name: raw_data
body.description: If the node is already enriched, then pass the raw data to prevent it from getting re-enriched.
